subject: Renewal onboarding refresh + capacity uplift — procurement steps and evidence
messages:
From: Sara Kapoor <sara.kapoor@acme-enterprises.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: vendor onboarding refresh + capacity uplift for Acme Enterprises

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you’re well — Acme is ready to move forward on the renewal and we plan to add a ~20% capacity uplift (estimated GPU hours) and extend the term to 24 months. Our procurement team requires a vendor onboarding refresh in our portal before we can process the renewed PO and route payment.

What we need from Redwood to unblock processing:
- Upload current SOC 2 evidence (or link to where we can verify).
- Signed/updated SOW (we can DocuSign).
- Completed vendor questionnaire fields visible in our portal (procure link below).
- Confirmation of proposed billing cadence and PO contact.

Target internal sign-off date on our side is end of next week if possible. I’ve attached a short checklist of our requirements and included the portal link for uploads.

Portal link: https://procure.acme-enterprises.com/vendor/refresh/ACME-42
DocuSign (SOW): https://www.docusign.net/Start/Signing?d=0a1b2c3d4e

Happy to jump on a quick call if it helps coordinate.

Thanks,
Sara Kapoor
VP, Procurement — Acme Enterprises
procure-ops@acme-enterprises.com
Attachment: requested_evidence_list.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kapoor <sara.kapoor@acme-enterprises.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: vendor onboarding refresh + capacity uplift for Acme Enterprises

Sara — thanks for the clear list. We can get the bulk of this uploaded within 48 hours. Quick notes from my side:

- SOC2 evidence: we’ll provide the AICPA report link and a short redacted package if needed.
- SOW: I’ll attach the updated SOW draft and send the DocuSign request once legal confirms a single clause change (term length).
- Portal questionnaire: Marissa will coordinate the portal uploads and confirm the fields you flagged.
- Billing/PO: please route the PO to finance@redwood.com and cc me; we’ll route internally to finance and legal.

Action items:
1) Marissa to confirm the portal upload owner and timeline.
2) Karthik — can you scope the approval path for a 20% capacity uplift and confirm if we should split the PO across two tranches?
3) Sara — confirm the cutoff date your system requires for renewal to hit the new term start.

I’ll attach our internal checklist. If anyone wants to schedule a 20-minute sync, I’m available Monday 10–12 PT.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_internal_onboard_checklist.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: vendor onboarding refresh + capacity uplift for Acme Enterprises

Evelyn / Karthik — I’ll take the portal owner task. A few operational details to call out so we don’t hit delays:

- Acme’s portal enforces a vendor recertification step that requires (1) signed SOW, (2) updated bank details/PO contact, and (3) SOC2 link or uploaded report. If any of these are missing the request sits in manual review (adds ~5 business days).
- I captured the fields they flagged in the attached screenshot; I’ll upload the SOC2 binder and the questionnaire answers once we have the final SOW.
- HubSpot deal ACME-2026-REC-42 needs the renewal amount and adjusted ARR so CS and Rev Ops can run billing forecasts. Please add the final numbers to the deal record before DocuSign.

Proposed immediate plan:
1) Evelyn to confirm SOW term and signable version by EOB Monday.
2) I upload SOC2 + questionnaire Tuesday morning.
3) Karthik to confirm PO routing and tranche plan Wednesday.

I’ll schedule a 15-min sync for Tuesday 9:30 PT to review portal screenshots and confirm fields.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendor_portal_screenshot.png

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: vendor onboarding refresh + capacity uplift for Acme Enterprises

Quick read on approvals and PO sequencing from finance/ops perspective: 

- For a 20% uplift we can either: (A) Add the uplift to the renewal PO in one go and route for single approval (faster) or (B) split the uplift into a second PO that covers Q3–Q4 consumption to stay within the current year budget lines.
- Recommendation: split into two tranches (70% renewal, 30% uplift) tied to billing periods. That reduces immediate budget impact on the customer and shortens internal approval for the renewal piece.
- I’ve attached a short rationale doc that explains why tranche splitting speeds procurement by keeping the renewal under the standard approval threshold.

Operational asks:
- Evelyn: confirm if Acme prefers single PO or split.
- Marissa: once the SOW is final, please add the exact ARR figures to HubSpot (deal link below) so Rev Ops can prepare invoices.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: capacity_bump_rationale.docx

From: Sara Kapoor <sara.kapoor@acme-enterprises.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procure-ops@acme-enterprises.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: vendor onboarding refresh + capacity uplift for Acme Enterprises

Evelyn — thanks for the quick responses and plan. We’ve uploaded the PO intake placeholders on our side and you should see a portal ticket (ID: PP-9843). I also uploaded the SOC2 binder and accepted the DocuSign SOW link — please send the finalized SOW for signature when ready.

Per our procurement constraints we prefer a single PO where possible, but we can accept the tranche approach if it expedites approval. Please route the final PO to: finance@acme-enterprises.com and cc procure-ops@acme-enterprises.com.

I’ll leave the portal ticket open and will confirm when our internal legal has completed their pass — target is EOD Thursday. If you can get the SOW to DocuSign by Wednesday midday that will help us meet the timeline.

Appreciate the coordination.

Regards,
Sara Kapoor
VP, Procurement — Acme Enterprises
Attachment: updated_SOW_Acme_2026.pdf
